notes.title: Lambda Launches Today!
notes.content:
Today, Lambda Spellcrafting Academy leaves Early Access! 

Thank you to everyone who has helped with testing out and providing feedback on early builds of the game. This would not have been possible without your help.

To celebrate this launch, a major content update is now available. This includes:
- many more levels
- a brand new section
- a story
- a "boss" level
- various gameplay improvements / polish

This launch is not the end of the updates. I have plans for much more content I plan to integrate into the game. More details on these future updates will be coming soon.

Enjoy the launch! Professor Whiskers has gone off for a nap, but looks forward to helping you learn the art of Spellcraft.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43830967/1683013c1594324ceddd576c451e81e7bffd4e5c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Winter Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I have just pushed an update for the game. This contains many frequently requested features to smooth over some parts of the game that were previously a bit rough.

Many players wanted more space to view the spell. Now you can minimize the chat window, giving you your entire screen for designing your spells.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43830967/469d03ea462169e53682039e55b4b550045db898.gif[/img]

On larger levels, sometimes you just want to start over. The trash button in the corner can be used to reset a level to its original state.

And sometimes you want to undo a mistake. Undo / redo buttons to the rescue! You can access these with the buttons in the corner, or standard hotkeys. Instead of CTRL+Z (undo) and CTRL+Y(redo), you can just use Z  and Y. Undo can also undo a "reset" action, in case you misclick.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43830967/4186cff9f8c763997cf3039710cfd595216b1eb2.gif[/img]

Happy gaming and happy holidays!

notes.title: Winter update coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello!

Thanks to everyone who has played the game so far, and a special thanks to players who have provided feedback.

I'm working on a patch that mostly focuses on "quality of life" type improvements, to improve gameplay in areas that currently feel a bit clunky.

The update should be available in the next few days. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Build 113: User experience & performance improvements
notes.content:
Just pushed build 113. Included in this update:

[list]
[*] Checklist optimization: Long running spells can no longer slow down the rest of the editor.
[*] Editing improvements: Replacing a word in the middle of your spell will no longer remove everything below. This makes it easier to replace similar words while building up your spells. See the gif for an example.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43830967/32dfff43aef56f6e11eec332ba4862596f28617d.gif[/img]

I have a few more editor improvements planned, then I'll swap back to working on content for a while.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Build 112: Improved level browser, lesson clarity, bug fixes
notes.content:
Just pushed build 112 for the Early Access version of the game. There have been a lot of changes recently that are only now getting pushed, since I had previously focused on getting the demo playable in the browser.

Now the Steam version of the game has these updates:
[list]
[*] Improved scaling for the level browser / spellbook: Entries better adjust to the size of your device.
[*] Bugfix for "ripeness checker" level. Previously certain spells could crash the game. The crash has been fixed. A future update will improve the visuals for this level.
[*] Bugfix: Certain levels previously appeared to unlock out-of-order. This has been fixed.
[*] Updated a few all menus are usable with mouse only.
[*] Improved dialogs for the first levels. Several users mentioned that the instructions were too wordy, so the update focuses on clearer & shorter explanations. The remaining levels will be updated in a future update.
[/list]

Have fun! As always, feel free to reach out via email, steam community, or the in-game feedback form.

notes.title: New section + 4 more levels
notes.content:
Build 100 is now available for early access players. This adds 4 new levels which will teach you about arrays.

I've also added a "challenge" section at the end, and moved a few earlier levels there. These levels were a fair bit harder than the others. This way they dont block progress.

I'm planning on adding a hinting system to the game, to make it less likely for players to get stuck on any one level.

Have fun!

- Alex

notes.title: Early Access Begins
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Lambda Spellcrafting Academy is now available via Early Access! The Early Access version of the game includes an extra set of levels, and a sandbox mode that will allow you to create and test your own spells.

More levels are coming soon.

Your feedback is always appreciated. Feel free to use:
- The in-game feedback form
- Steam community
- Social media DM (BitTwiddleGames on Reddit and Twitter)

notes.title: Demo build 95 released
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I've just released build 95 of the demo. This contains a few fixes and changes based on user feedback:

- Added a new level to better explain the checklist
- Improved several levels so the checklist can accurately indicate partial success on a few levels.
- Added the version number under the settings, so it is easier for players to check that they have the latest version
- Prevent running "incomplete / higher order spells" for now.

Thanks to everyone who has provided feedback.

Have fun!

notes.title: Build 90: Level browser, save / load support
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I've just pushed build 90 of the demo. This includes a new level browser, so you can progress through the levels as you choose. You no longer need to try to complete the demo in a single sitting, as your progress will be saved.

Your solutions to the levels will also be autosaved. If you want to revisit a level later, you can do so without worrying about losing your partial solutions.

I've also been working on producing a bunch of additional levels which aren't included in the demo, but I plan to include in an upcoming Early Access launch. If you know anyone else that might be interested in the game, feel free to share so they can wishlist and get notified when Early Access begins.

Thanks everyone for playing and providing feedback so far :)

- Alex

notes.title: Demo build 85 : New level, clearer spellcasting.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I just pushed build 85 of the demo, which contains
- A new "if" level, which is simpler and should be more accessible to newcomers.
- Clearer visualizations while casting spells, which hides internal details not relevant to your spell.
- Edge hints, which let you know if you have parts of your spell off-screen. This should make it easier
to find your spell if you lose it, and also make it harder to miss the added visualizations.

I've also been working on many new levels, which I plan to start playtesting in the near future. Make sure to sign up for the playtest if you would like to help test the rest of the content before the full release.

https://forms.gle/ZuvBAxfoyNvQsDuq7

notes.title: Demo build 70 - Visual improvements
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who tried out my game a part of PuzzleFest last week. I really appreciate all the feedback you've provided.

I just pushed a new build of the demo. I had also pushed several updates throughout the festival, but forgot to announce. So below is a summary of the changes since the last announcement:

- Improved scaling for high resolution screens. Previously a lot of the text was near-impossible to read at
resolutions greater than 1920x1080.

- Card artwork for cards in hand. This will make it easier to understand the effects of the various cards. Descriptions aren't inserted yet, and for now all cards have the same artwork.

- Improved animations for card replacement. Rather than "1+2 => 3", you'll see a new card pop out and replace the old. This should make it easier to understand whats happening when you cast your spell.

- The background of the spell zooms along with your spell, giving a better sense of depth.

- Changed stacking for the cards. With big hand sizes, this will make it easier to find your cards.

- Performance optimizations within spell animations.

notes.title: Demo build 55 - Performance improvements and more
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I've just released a new build of the demo. Included in this change:

- Improved fullscreen performance on Windows
- Added a pause menu during the game (Esc)
- Reworked several levels based on user feedback
- Improved zooming smoothness of text
- Added the ability to disable voice

Have fun!

notes.title: Demo Build 50 - Added voice system
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I just pushed an update to the demo of the game. New changes are also reflected in the new trailer on the store page.

Main Changes include:
- Added a new 'voice' system which is synced to dialog. 
- Improved font scaling, which previously caused cards to be hard to read while zoomed out.
- Zoom smoothing.

Smaller changes include:
- improved audio performance
- improved spell layout, words can no longer overlap on large spells.
- improved appearance of mouse-over visualization for words
- fixed some inconsistencies.

notes.title: Demo build 45 - Graphics update
notes.content: I've just pushed demo build 45, the first of many graphics updates. The words you use to build your spells now appear more like playing cards. Additionally, I've fixed some inconsistency in the animations.
